description: This file defines the ConfigurationProvider class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically within the STS regional endpoints namespace. It provides methods to generate configuration providers that supply endpoint configuration based on environment variables, ini files, or default fallbacks, as well as handling caching and unwrapping configuration objects.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods to generate configuration provider callables for AWS STS regional endpoints, utilizing environment variables, ini files, fallback defaults, caching, and unwrapping logic.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that loads configuration from environment variables, ini files, or fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that reads endpoint configuration type from environment variables.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback configuration options with default regional endpoints type.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that loads configuration from an AWS config ini file, with optional profile and filename parameters.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Converts various forms of configuration inputs into a ConfigurationInterface instance, waiting on promises or handling raw strings and arrays.
